pages.text: Your breath lasts far longer underwater, and you mine underwater at full speed. Found in $(thing)shipwreck treasure$(), $(thing)ocean ruins$(), and rare trail ruins.
Fire burns on you for $(l)half as long$(), and you take $(l)30% less fire damage$(). Any wearer can use it, but Branded bearers fighting $(l)Living Ember$() will be glad of it.
At light level 7 or lower, gain $(l)+10% movement speed$() and $(l)+15% attack damage$(). A relic for caves, deep dark, and night raids.
Grants $(l)+1 max heart$(). When a hit leaves you below half health, gain $(l)Regeneration I$() for 4s. Cooldown: $(l)20 seconds$().
